concept.material: patinated bronze and brushed copper plate
concept.internal_detail: interlocking brass gears and fine coiled hairsprings
concept.button: a small faceted ruby button set into the corner seam
concept.shell_mechanic: The rhombic bronze cassette splits along its central diagonal ridge and the heavy side plates fold apart outward like opening jaws
concept.emerging_parts: Four short jointed stub legs and a broad flat snout block
concept.signature_move: its inset glass eyes glow a pale yellow, and its wide bronze jaw plates swing open and snap shut once with a sharp metallic clack
concept.turkish: Tazmanya canavari (Avustralya civarinda yasayan, etobur, keseli memeli) — oluklu esdortgen kaset, patinajli bronz ve fircalanmis bakir levha
